problem_statement: The ThemeWagon Kaiadmin Lite template is a static multi-page Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard (Dashboard, Forms, Tables, Charts, Widgets) that share one sidebar/topbar shell and local Kaiadmin assets. A shared 'State Continuity Control Center' is meant to sit at the top of the content area on ALL FIVE admin pages so the operator's Revenue Ops workspace context follows them across routes. The center shows the workspace, the active module, the saved cross-page handoff, and the 'kaia-state-continuity-2026' state token, plus a row of quick links and a 'Pin <module> State' button whose 'Last action' readout must update when the module is pinned. In the shipped state the center has three coupled defects: (1) its four-metric row was laid out as a single fixed-width, non-wrapping flex grid, so on a 390px mobile viewport it pushes the whole admin page past the viewport and the dashboard scrolls horizontally while desktop/tablet look fine; (2) it was only mounted on the Dashboard page, so Forms/Tables/Charts/Widgets silently miss the shared control center; and (3) the Pin button moves its pressed highlight but never re-syncs the 'Last action' readout. Evolve the cross-page state experience so the control center is present and consistent on all five admin pages, the mobile pages have no horizontal overflow, and clicking 'Pin Dashboard State' updates the 'Last action' readout to 'Pinned Dashboard route state' — while preserving every page's existing sidebar, topbar, cards, charts, tables, form controls, local assets, and static architecture exactly as they are.
required_content: Fix the layout so the 390px mobile admin pages (mobile_initial, mobile_forms_pin, mobile_tables_memory) have no horizontal overflow: the document scroll width must not exceed the viewport beyond a small tolerance.

Mount the State Continuity Control Center consistently on ALL FIVE admin pages (index.html, forms/forms.html, tables/tables.html, charts/charts.html, widgets.html) with its route-specific 'Active module' context: Dashboard, Forms, Tables, Charts, and Widgets respectively.

Keep every control-center metric visible and readable: Workspace (Revenue Ops), Active module, Saved handoff, and the continuity token, plus the 'State Continuity Control Center' title, the 'State continuity' eyebrow, and the 'State token: kaia-state-continuity-2026' chip.

Wire the 'Pin <module> State' button so that clicking it updates the 'Last action' readout to 'Pinned <module> route state' (and moves the pressed highlight); the terminal readout must reflect the pinned module, not stay 'Idle'.

Keep the control center's Kaiadmin visual language intact: white card, #1572e8 primary-blue accent, purple eyebrow, light metric tiles, muted uppercase labels; do not recolor it to an off-palette dark treatment.
Preserve original Dashboard, Forms, Tables, Charts, Widgets content, the Kaiadmin sidebar/topbar shell, cards, Chart.js charts, and DataTables.

Preserve local assets and static architecture including assets/css/kaiadmin.min.css, assets/css/sitecontinuum-state.css, assets/js/kaiadmin.min.js, assets/js/sitecontinuum-state.js; do not add a framework, build step, router, dependency, or remote asset.

Evolve the state experience in the control center's own stylesheet (assets/css/sitecontinuum-state.css) and its script (assets/js/sitecontinuum-state.js), not by removing the center, deleting cards/tables/charts, or masking overflow with an element-level clip.
design_constraints: Keep the static Bootstrap 5 admin architecture and the existing Kaiadmin visual language: white cards, rounded corners, #1572e8 primary accent, #6861ce eyebrow, light metric tiles, muted uppercase labels, and the current sidebar/topbar layout.

The change is a cross-page state-continuity evolution of the control center at the top of .page-inner, not a replacement for the dashboard cards, forms, tables, charts, or widgets, and not a new route, modal, or detached app.
Do not change navigation links, the sidebar collapse behavior, chart scripts, table markup, or form markup while evolving the control center.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow, and the control center must remain visually intact (on-palette) on desktop and mobile.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial verify canonical dashboard rendering of the control center across desktop and mobile; the reference wraps the metric row on mobile so there is no horizontal overflow while the unrepaired baseline overflows.

desktop_dashboard_center scrolls the control center into view and verifies it renders as a clean, on-palette multi-metric strip with the workspace/module/handoff/token metrics and the Idle 'Last action' readout.

desktop_forms_pin, desktop_tables_memory, desktop_charts_memory, desktop_widgets_memory verify the shared control center is present with the correct 'Active module' route context on every admin page (cross-page consistency).

desktop_dashboard_return clicks 'Pin Dashboard State' and verifies the 'Last action' readout terminal state becomes 'Pinned Dashboard route state' (the interaction actually updates the readout, not just the pressed highlight).
tablet_tables_memory and tablet_charts_memory verify the control center on tablet with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_forms_pin and mobile_tables_memory verify the Forms and Tables pages stack without horizontal overflow on mobile after the repair.

change_completion: The 390px mobile admin pages have no horizontal overflow after the repair.
The State Continuity Control Center is present and consistent on all five admin pages, and Pin Dashboard State updates the 'Last action' readout terminal state.
design_consistency: The evolved center keeps the Kaiadmin visual language: white card, #1572e8 primary accent, purple eyebrow, light metric tiles, muted uppercase labels.
The change extends the center's own stylesheet + script rather than removing the center, editing unrelated files, hiding overflow at the element level, or recoloring off-palette.
regression: Original sidebar, topbar, dashboard cards, charts, tables, forms, and widgets remain present and usable.
No new framework, route system, dependency, or remote asset is introduced.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and mobile states have no horizontal overflow after the repair.
The control center metrics remain readable and fully visible on 390px mobile.
evaluation_rubric.scoring_notes: A correct patch is a cross-page responsive + interaction evolution of the control center. Patches that merely clip overflow (overflow-x:hidden while keeping a fixed-width nowrap grid), mount the center on one page only, recolor it off-palette, or move the pressed pin without updating the readout should fail the no-overflow, cross-page dom, visual_regression, or interaction checks.

author_notes: Slot slot_284 (L4) evolves the shared State Continuity Control Center across the five Kaiadmin admin pages. The graded surface is the center's stylesheet (assets/css/sitecontinuum-state.css) and script (assets/js/sitecontinuum-state.js). The bad leg fails four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow (masked mobile overflow), visual_regression (off-palette dark restyle), dom_assertions (center missing on Forms/Tables/Charts/Widgets), and interaction_assertions (Pin never re-syncs the Last action readout).
